skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic and advanced knowledge of commercial law, including legal conditions for domestic and foreign traders, goods, and services in commerce.
Understand legal conditions for domestic and international goods trading and service provision.
Understand legal procedures for resolving commercial disputes.
Develop the ability to independently research and accumulate knowledge.
Apply teamwork skills in group presentations and discussions.
Effectively present and communicate research findings.
Analyze and solve problems related to commercial law.
